source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of graph characteristics (PDF 113).

blocks.text: Graph ki kuch basic (bunyadi) features (khaas baatein) hain jo use samajhne aur istemal karne mein madad deti hain:

items: Vertices (nodes): graph ke alag alag nuqte ya cheezein. Maslan social network ke graph mein har user ek vertex hai.
Edges (links): vertices ke beech connections (rabte). Maslan transport ke graph mein do shehron ko jorne wali har sarak ek edge hai.

blocks.prompt: Aeroplanes ki flights (parwazon) ke graph mein vertices aur edges kya honge?
blocks.explanation: Vertices airports, aur edges un ke beech flights ke raaste.

items: Graph ki features: vertices (cheezein) aur edges (connections).
